skill.name: typescript-review
skill.description: Review TypeScript and JavaScript changes against Metabase coding standards, type safety rules, test expectations, and React best practices.
skill.summary: Guides TypeScript and JavaScript pull request review for Metabase codebases.
skill.author: metabase

content.value_statement: TypeScript reviewers need consistent checks for style, tests, JSDoc, and type safety. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Metabase review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Metabase coding standard issues in TypeScript and JavaScript diffs.
Guides reviewers to check ESLint, Prettier, and TypeScript validation results.
Calls out missing or unclear JSDoc comments when public APIs need explanation.
Reviews React changes for common project best practices.
Suggests targeted unit or ClojureScript test commands for changed files.
limitations: It does not define every Metabase coding rule by itself.
It relies on repository tools being available in the working environment.
It cannot prove runtime behavior without relevant tests or build output.
It is scoped to TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and related test review.

use_cases.title: Review a frontend pull request
use_cases.description: Check changed TypeScript and React files for style, safety, comments, and test coverage before merge.

use_cases.title: Prepare a change for review
use_cases.description: Run through linting, formatting, type checks, and focused tests before requesting feedback.

use_cases.title: Standardize review comments
use_cases.description: Apply consistent Metabase review criteria across JavaScript and TypeScript changes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic diff review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small TypeScript change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this TypeScript diff for Metabase style, type safety, and obvious test gaps. Focus on actionable comments.

prompt_templates.title: React component review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of frontend component changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these React changes for Metabase conventions, props typing, state handling, accessibility risks, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Pre-merge validation plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation before approving a pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation plan for this JavaScript or TypeScript pull request. Include lint, formatting, type checks, and focused tests.

prompt_templates.title: Comprehensive review audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for a larger multi-file change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this pull request for coding standards, JSDoc quality, type safety, React practices, regressions, and missing tests.

output_examples.input: A TypeScript pull request changes shared utility types and one unit test.
output: Type safety issue: the new utility type accepts undefined values that existing callers do not handle.
Test gap: add a case for the empty input path before merging.
Validation: run the TypeScript check and the focused unit test for the changed file.

output_examples.input: A React component diff adds new props and changes rendering conditions.
output: React concern: the conditional branch hides the loading state when data is empty.
Typing concern: make the new callback prop explicit and document when it fires.
Test suggestion: add coverage for loaded, empty, and error states.

output_examples.input: A reviewer wants a short pre-merge checklist for a JavaScript change.
output: Confirm linting passes for the affected package.
Confirm formatting does not change unrelated files.
Run focused tests for the changed behavior and note any skipped coverage.

best_practices: Review the diff first, then use project commands to confirm risky areas.
Ask for focused tests when behavior changes or type coverage weakens.
Keep review comments specific, actionable, and tied to changed lines.
anti_patterns: Do not approve changes only because formatting passes.
Do not request broad test runs when a focused command proves the behavior.
Do not ignore unclear JSDoc on exported functions or shared types.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews TypeScript, JavaScript, React, JSDoc, style, type safety, and test expectations for Metabase changes.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It lists useful project commands, but the user or agent decides whether to run them.

faq.question: Can it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. It supports reviewers by organizing checks and surfacing likely issues.

faq.question: Does it work outside Metabase?
faq.answer: It can help with similar projects, but its guidance is written for Metabase conventions.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide with a prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the relevant diff, changed files, test context, and any review goals.
